contingence.definition: a future event or circumstance that is possible but cannot be predicted with certainty

independence.definition: the freedom to govern yourself or make your own decisions

stick.definition: to become fixed in place or to continue doing something

assignment.definition: a task or piece of work given to someone as part of a job or course of study

literator.definition: A person who is well-educated and writes literature.

almost.example: I almost missed the bus this morning.

conformably.definition: in a way that follows rules, standards, or expectations

chil.definition: a feeling of coldness in the air or body

chil.exampleCn: 今早空气中有些寒意，所以带件外套。

recreant.definition: a coward or a traitor; lacking courage or loyalty
recreant.example: He was labeled a recreant for abandoning his team during the crisis.
recreant.exampleCn: 他因为在危机中抛弃团队而被贴上懦夫的标签。

ducal.definition: relating to a duke or duchy

explicably.definition: in a way that can be explained or understood

explicably.exampleCn: 销售额的下降可解释为是由于新的竞争对手。

cal.definition: a unit of energy, often used to measure the energy content of food

sit.definition: to rest with the body supported on the buttocks

verifiably.definition: in a way that can be proved or confirmed

verifiably.exampleCn: 这些数据经证实是从可靠来源收集的。

humidify.definition: to make something slightly wet, especially the air in a room

humidify.exampleCn: 冬天，你可能需要给卧室加湿以避免皮肤干燥。

complete.definition: having all parts or elements; finished

asternal.definition: not connected to the sternum; lacking a sternum

criterial.definition: Serving as a criterion; used for judging or deciding.
criterial.example: The criterial factors for job promotion include performance and teamwork.
criterial.exampleCn: 工作晋升的标准因素包括绩效和团队合作。

protonic.definition: relating to or consisting of protons

protonic.exampleCn: 材料中的质子导电性对燃料电池技术很重要。

swiftness.definition: the quality of being quick or rapid

actife.definition: involving action or movement; engaged in activity

suppre.definition: to put an end to something by force; to keep something hidden or from being known

adviser.definition: A person who gives advice, especially someone with expertise in a particular field.

domesticat.definition: to tame an animal and keep it as a pet or on a farm

domesticat.exampleCn: 许多野生动物很难驯化成家庭宠物。

coach.definition: a person who trains a sports team; a bus for long journeys

coach.exampleCn: 我每天乘坐长途客车上班。

dominant.example: The dominant theme in his speech was economic growth.

involv.definition: to include or affect someone or something as a necessary part or result

eviction.definition: the act of forcing someone to leave a property, usually by legal order

exaggerat.definition: to make something seem larger, more important, or more serious than it really is

quant.definition: a person who uses mathematical models in finance

sacr.definition: an act of giving up something valued for the sake of something else

subsidy.definition: money given by a government to support a business or service

glottal.definition: Relating to the glottis (the opening between the vocal cords).

push.definition: to apply force to move something away from you
